Get P. LEAGUE+ Play-by-Play

Source: R/pleague.R
pleague_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of one finished game (2022-23 on) in game order, with shot x / y and the clip references.

Endpoint: GET https://pleagueofficial.com/api/playbyplay.php?uuid={uuid} (after the game page, which holds the uuid)

Usage

pleague_pbp(gid)

Arguments

gid

Required. P. LEAGUE+ game id on the site: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season (197 = the 2022-23 opener, 662 = the 2025-26 opener), e.g. 197; gid in pleague_schedule. Only finished games are served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Play-by-play of one finished game (2022-23 on) in game order, with shot x / y and the clip references. An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sportsdataverse-py pleague_pbp):

col_nametypedescription
gidintegerP. LEAGUE+ game id on the site: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season (1-12 = 2020-21 pre-season, 13 = the 2020-21 opener, 197 = the 2022-23 opener, 662 = the 2025-26 opener), with gaps; a row id, not a count. The {gid} of /game/{gid}.
seqintegerPosition of the play in game order, 1-based (the fragment lists plays oldest first within the fragment).
periodcharacterPeriod label: Q1-Q4, then OT1, OT2 for overtime.
period_nointeger1-based position of the period: 1-4 for Q1-Q4, then 5 for OT1, 6 for OT2.
clockcharacterGame clock REMAINING in the period 'mm:ss' (counts down; Q1 opens at 12:00, OT at 05:00).
seconds_leftintegerThe clock as whole seconds remaining in the period (08:34 = 514), derived by the parser.
sidecharacterSide of the acting team: away or home (the fragment places the play in the away or home column).
jerseycharacterShirt number of the acting player as printed; null on team rows and where the name is printed without a number.
player_zhcharacterActing player's name as printed; null on team rows (a team rebound, timeout or shot-clock violation). The page prints no player ids: join to the box on side, jersey and name_zh.
actioncharacterAction code (one of the codes listed under "Action codes" below; an unseen phrase is refused as layout drift).
action_zhcharacterThe action phrase as printed, Traditional Chinese ((Chinese text) = dunk, made; '#35 (Chinese text)' = '#35 {player} dunk, made'); blank on an unlabelled row. Each of the 82 observed phrases maps to one action code (see action).
action_encharacterEnglish meaning of the play's phrase (see action), so a free throw reads its own trip, e.g. 'free throw 2, made'; null for a code outside the observed table.
text_zhcharacterThe whole printed text of the play, e.g. '#35 (Chinese text)' = '#35 {player} dunk, made'.
ft_numberintegerWhich free throw of the trip this is (1, 2 or 3), from (Chinese text); null on every other play.
ft_awardedintegerFree throws awarded in the trip (1, 2 or 3) from (Chinese text); set only on the FIRST free throw's row, null otherwise.
pointsintegerPoints scored by the play from the '+2' / '+3' / '+1' tag; null when the tag is a bare '+'.
score_awayintegerAway score after the play, from the 'A - H' cell (AWAY first, unlike the box); null on plays that print no score (substitutions, rebounds, jump balls).
score_homeintegerHome score after the play, from the 'A - H' cell; null when the play prints no score.
xdoubleShot / play x: PERCENT (0-100) of the court LENGTH in the PHYSICAL court frame (not normalised per team): baskets near x = 5 and x = 95, teams swap ends at half-time. The Preciser shot list uses a home-attacks-95 frame: x_vendor = 100 - x in the halves where the home team attacks x < 50. Null on plays without a location. Court 28.75 m long.
ydoubleShot / play y: PERCENT (0-100) of the court WIDTH in the physical frame (baskets at y = 50); y_vendor = 100 - y in the halves where the home team attacks x < 50. Which sideline is y = 0 is unverified. Court 15.25 m wide.
nice_playlogicalTrue when the site stars the play (a nice_play row class and a starred clip).
video_uuidcharacterClip uuid (key space: the clip vendor tryspot); null on plays without a clip (about 3 in 4). The clip urls are never kept: they carry a vendor access key.
synergy_play_idcharacterSynergy Sports play uuid of the clip (the site links Synergy); a string on every one of the 50,862 clips in the corpus.
video_stat_categorycharacterThe clip's own stat label (ast, blk, ft_made, ft_miss, pfoul, reb_d, reb_o, stl, three_made, three_miss, timeout, turnover, two_made, two_miss): it names the PLAY the clip shows, not always this row's action (a rebound row carries the missed shot's clip).
tryspot_player_idintegerPlayer id in the clip vendor's key space (an integer such as 59476); NOT the box player_id.
video_created_atcharacterWhen the clip was created, UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in pleague_schedule().

Action codes

Each code of action, its meaning and [the number of plays] in 258,183 plays of 404 finished 2022-23..2025-26 games (82 printed phrases plus the blank row):

  • ast: assist [17,020]

  • blk: block [3,181]

  • review_coach_challenge: video review: coach's challenge (2025-26 onward; the printed text ends with a bare comma) [videoReview, coachChallenge,, 82]

  • tov_3sec: turnover: 3-second violation [249]

  • tov_5sec: turnover: 5-second violation [40]

  • tov_8sec: turnover: 8-second violation [26]

  • tov_backcourt: turnover: backcourt violation [96]

  • tov_bad_pass: turnover: bad pass [6,325]

  • tov_ball_handling: turnover: ball-handling [3,547]

  • tov_carrying: turnover: carrying the ball [47]

  • tov_double_dribble: turnover: double dribble [53]

  • tov_offensive: turnover: offensive (kind not recorded) [1,007]

  • tov_offensive_goaltending: turnover: offensive goaltending [4]

  • tov_other: turnover: other [51]

  • tov_out_of_bounds: turnover: ball out of bounds [441]

  • tov_shot_clock: turnover: shot-clock violation [489]

  • tov_travel: turnover: travelling [718]

  • unlabelled: row has a player but no action text; in the corpus a shot with x/y followed by a rebound, i.e. a missed shot (inferred) [(blank), 169]
